subject: TouristVisa per-method idempotency guard
description: TouristVisa.installBlockers calls tryInstall() up to 3x/page (immediate + DOMContentLoaded + setTimeout), and wrapIfExists has no __touristWrapped guard, so each blocked method (ModuleProgress.complete/completeQuiz/AchievementManager.unlock/check) can be wrapped up to 3x — layered duplicate blockers + nondeterministic wrap order. Add a per-method __touristWrapped flag like LinuxReplay's __linuxReplayWrapped. Nancy->Chris->commit. NO deploy. From backlog 2026-07-11.
